goals_commitment_shape.name: goals_commitment_shape
goals_commitment_shape.value: "goals"."kind" <> 'commitment' or ("goals"."target_minutes" is not null and "goals"."period" is not null)

focus_sessions_shape.name: focus_sessions_shape
focus_sessions_shape.value:
("focus_sessions"."status" in ('running', 'paused')) = ("focus_sessions"."ended_at" is null)
        and ("focus_sessions"."status" = 'paused') = ("focus_sessions"."paused_at" is not null)
        and ("focus_sessions"."status" = 'completed') = ("focus_sessions"."minutes" is not null)

quest_instances_shape.name: quest_instances_shape
quest_instances_shape.value:
("quest_instances"."status" = 'completed') = ("quest_instances"."completed_at" is not null)
        and ("quest_instances"."status" in ('expired', 'rerolled', 'cancelled')) = ("quest_instances"."closed_at" is not null)
        and "quest_instances"."period_start" <= "quest_instances"."period_end"
